From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Nguyen <alicia@stellarretail.com>; ops@stellarretail.com
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Subject: Stellar POC — data-driven one-pager & permission to record 15m

Hi Alicia / Stellar ops team,

Great working with you this week — thanks again for the fast feedback during the POC run. Quick recap of the core outcomes from our validated test window (sampled across 7 stores / 3 weeks):

- Average search latency reduced by ~42% (from 420ms -> 245ms) when the model is served via Redwood batching + prefix caching.
- Conversion uplift on personalized search queries: +5.8% relative (A/B, statistically significant at p<.05).
- Inference cost per 1k queries decreased ~32% using our suggested quantization profile and request-level caching.
- Error / hallucination rate on SKU mapping tasks dropped from 7.1% -> 2.9% based on manual review sample.

I attached a short PDF with the export tables and the configuration we used (Stellar_POC_results.pdf).

Would you be open to two small asks to help us turn this into a one-pager and a short marketing clip?

1) A 15-minute recorded call (we record for internal editing) with someone on product/ops to capture a 60–90s soundbite we can quote. We can do a quick live script so it’s super low friction. I’m suggesting 3 short slots: Tue 8/31 10:00–10:15 PT, Wed 9/1 14:00–14:15 PT, or Thu 9/2 11:30–11:45 PT — or pick anywhere on my Calendly: https://calendly.com/olga-p/15min

2) A two-line attribution / blurb we can put on a one-pager and in a case snippet. If helpful I can pre-draft a suggested line you can sign off on.

Two quick notes on sensitive items: we will not publish any revenue numbers or contract details without explicit legal approval. If there are internal phrasing preferences (e.g., avoid the word “lift” vs. “improvement”), tell me and we’ll use your exact language.

If you’re okay with this, we’ll also ask for a high-res logo file and contact for legal/comms so we can circulate the final draft before publishing.

Thanks again — happy to keep this short and low effort on your side. Attachments: Stellar_POC_results.pdf (tables + charts).

Best,
Olga Petrov
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0128
Redwood Inference
